Do not continue driving a vehicle without functioning brakes.
After a tire blowout, grip the wheel firmly and keep the vehicle moving straight.
With a blown tire, release the accelerator, slow gradually and brake lightly.
After a blowout, stop off the road in a safe place whenever possible.

After engine failure, pull off the roadway and expect that braking may require much more pedal pressure.

If the headlight switch and high beams do not restore lighting, use available flashers, turn signals or fog lamps while pulling off safely as soon as possible.
If the accelerator sticks, keep watching the road and shift promptly to neutral.
With a stuck accelerator, brake with steady pressure and pull off when safe before turning the engine off.
